messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's entire outfit with the complete target outfit shown in the reference images, including the top, bottoms, and footwear. Use the first reference image for the front view of the outfit and the second reference image for the back view. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects of the person and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the person's whole outfit with the top, the bottoms, and the footwear, as shown from the front and back in the reference images. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands facing away, then raises her right arm to brush her hair back and smooth it down over several seconds.","camera":"Static medium shot from behind at roughly waist height, keeping her centered in frame.","clothing":"A sleeveless, patterned orange-brown halter top and light-colored high-waisted pants with a black belt.","hair_color":"Dark brown to black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair pulled back into two low pigtails or buns at the nape.","identity":"A slim woman with a bare back, seen from behind, with no visible facial features.","scene":"An outdoor fairground or boardwalk with a red carousel structure on the left, a striped-roof carousel on the right, and a pale sandy ground under bright daylight."},"uncertain":["Exact hair color (appears dark brown/black but lighting is warm)","Whether the top is a halter or one-shoulder style (front not visible)"]}}

arguments.observed_change: The blue-and-white patterned dress was replaced with a brown patterned sleeveless top and light gray high-waisted pants with a black belt. The person's hair, pose, animation, camera, and fairground scene remain essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's entire outfit with the reference outfit: brown patterned sleeveless top, light gray high-waisted pants with black belt, and matching footwear, while leaving non-clothing aspects unchanged.
uncertain: Footwear is not visible in the waist-up framing, so it cannot be confirmed that the reference sandals were applied.
